title: Robust Power and Sample Size Calculations in Quasi-likelihood Models: Methods and Practice
summary: Accurate power and sample size (PSS) calculations are essential for designing studies that use quasi-likelihood (QL) models, which extend generalized linear models (GLMs) to settings where the full distribution of the outcome is not specified. Traditional PSS approaches often rely on restrictive distributional assumptions, limiting their applicability when responses have non-standard distributions, variance functions are misspecified, or when predictors exhibit complex dependence structures.
